description:
Read current subscription pricing and access allowances before requesting an invoice.

        Returns items with plan_id, USDC reference price, period_seconds, concurrent_slots,
        rotation/renewal policy, plus plan_hash and collection_enabled. A held collection
        state prevents new payments. Use discover_botrotation for payment routes and
        agent_onboarding to purchase through the delegated REST/SDK workflow. No arguments,
        authentication or payment required; this read neither subscribes nor reserves slots.
        Upstream failure returns an MCP tool error.
name: subscription_plans

plan_id.description: Stable plan identifier used by authenticated invoice requests.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

price_usdc.description: Decimal USDC reference price, excluding network gas.
price_usdc.title: Price Usdc

collection_enabled.description: False means new payment collection is held; this call never purchases access.
collection_enabled.title: Collection Enabled

plan_hash.description: Current plan document SHA-256, distinct from the rental terms hash.
plan_hash.title: Plan Hash
